title: Lady Gaga’s Haus Labs shares apology following bronzer shade range backlash
summary: Haus Labs, the brand founded by singer and actress Lady Gaga, has shared an apology statement on its social media channels following creator feedback around the lack of inclusivity in the shades for its new bronzing sku, Sun Dipped Bronzing Veil
